Field.Name: MsgSeqNum

Field.Name: SenderCompID

Field.Name: SenderSubID

Field.Name: SendingTime
Field.Description: Time of message transmission in UTC. Format: YYYYMMDD-HH:MM:SS.uuu

Field.Name: TargetCompID
Field.Description: Identifies the party receiving the message.

Field.Name: TargetSubID
Field.Description: Sub identifier of the party receiving the message.

Field.Name: PossResend
Field.Description: Set to Y in messages from MIAX during certain failure/recovery scenarios.

Field.Name: OnBehalfOfCompID

Field.Name: OnBehalfOfSubID
Field.Description: Only applicable to messages sent to MIAX.

Field.Name: OrigSendingTime
Field.Description: Required for resent messages. Format: YYYYMMDD-HH:MM:SS.uuu

Field.Name: DeliverToCompID

Field.Description: Only applicable to messages sent from MIAX.

Field.Name: CheckSum
Field.Description: Always the last field of a FIX message.

Field.Name: EncryptMethod
Field.Description: Encryption is not supported and hence this field is ignored (always unencrypted).

Field.Name: HeartBtInt
Field.Description: Value specified in seconds. Must be greater than 0 and the same value must be used by both sides.

Field.Name: ResetSeqNumFlag
Field.Description: Indicates both sides of a FIX session should reset sequence numbers.

Field.Name: TestReqID
Field.Description: Required when the heartbeat is the result of a Test Request message.

Field.Name: TestReqID
Field.Description: Test request identifier to be returned in the resulting Heartbeat.

Field.Name: BeginSeqNo
Field.Description: Message sequence number of first message in range to be resent.

Field.Name: EndSeqNo
Field.Description: Message sequence number of last message in range to be resent.

Field.Name: RefSeqNum
Field.Description: MsgSeqNum of rejected message.

Field.Name: RefTagID
Field.Description: Required if reject reason refers to a specific tag.

Field.Name: RefMsgType
Field.Description: The MsgType of the FIX message being referenced.

Field.Name: SessionRejectReason
Field.Description: Code to identify reason for a session-level Reject message.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Supplied if there is a need to provide more information regarding the reject.

Field.Name: GapFillFlag
Field.Description: Indicates that this message is replacing administrative or application messages which will not be resent.

Field.Name: NewSeqNo
Field.Description: New sequence number.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Can be used to send readable information to the recipient.

Field.Name: Account
Field.Description: As specified on the order. Optional field.

Field.Name: AvgPx
Field.Description: Average price of the fills on this order.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: ClOrdID of the order.

Field.Name: CumQty
Field.Description: Total number of contracts filled.

Field.Name: ExecID
Field.Description: Unique identifier for each Execution Report message. Uniqueness is guaranteed within a single trading day.

Field.Name: ExecInst
Field.Description: Instructions for order handling on exchange. Same value as entered in the order. Valid values: f = ISO.

Field.Name: ExecTransType
Field.Description: Identifies the trade type. Valid values: 0 = New.

Field.Name: LastPx
Field.Description: Price of the last fill. Not required for ExecTransType = 3 (Status).

Field.Name: LastShares
Field.Description: Quantity of bought/sold contracts on the last fill. Not required for ExecTransType = 3 (Status).

Field.Name: OrderID
Field.Description: OrderID, as assigned by MIAX, is required to be unique for each chain of orders.

Field.Name: OrderQty
Field.Description: The number of contracts (total order quantity).

Field.Name: OrdStatus
Field.Description: Identifies the current status of an order. Valid values: 1 = Partially Filled, 2 = Filled, 6 = Pending Cancel.

Field.Name: OrdType
Field.Description: Order type specified on the order. Valid values: 1 = Market, 2 = Limit.

Field.Name: OrigClOrdID
Field.Description: ClOrdID of the canceled or replaced order.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Price for limit orders (OrdType = 2).

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Side of order. Valid values: 1 = Buy, 2 = Sell, 5 = Sell Short (stock leg), 6 = Sell Short Exempt (stock leg).

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: For Option Legs: the 6 character OCC Security Symbol (Class). For Equity Legs: the OCC Options underlying symbol or stock ticker symbol.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: For Cancel/Replace with ExecType 6 or E, partial canceled quantity (CxlQty:value). For Unsolicited Cancel (ExecType = 4), a freeform human readable reason.

Field.Name: TimeInForce
Field.Description: Specifies how long the order remains in effect.

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: Time of transaction expressed in UTC.

Field.Name: OpenClose
Field.Description: Specifies if this order opens or closes a position. Valid values: O = Open, C = Close.

Field.Name: ExecType
Field.Description: Identifies the type of execution report.

Field.Name: LeavesQty
Field.Description: Number of open contracts for further execution. LeavesQty = 0 if Canceled or Rejected, otherwise OrderQty - CumQty.

Field.Name: SecurityType
Field.Description: The type of security. Valid values: OPT or MLEG.

Field.Name: MaturityMonthYear
Field.Description: Option leg only. Expiration month and year. Format: YYYYMM.

Field.Name: PutOrCall
Field.Description: Option leg only. Valid values: 0 = Put, 1 = Call.

Field.Name: StrikePrice
Field.Description: Option leg only. Strike price for an option.

Field.Name: CustomerOrFirm
Field.Description: Specifies the order origin type specified on the order.

Field.Name: MaturityDay
Field.Description: Option leg only. Expiration day of month. Format: DD.

Field.Name: SecurityExchange
Field.Description: Exchange ID (MIC code) of the Option Exchange on which this execution occurred when other than MIAX.

Field.Name: MultiLegReportingType
Field.Description: Used to indicate what an Execution Report represents for Multileg orders only. Valid values: 2 = Individual Leg, 3 = Multileg Security.

Field.Name: CFICode
Field.Description: CFI code for the individual leg. Present only for Multileg equity leg.

Field.Name: IndividualAllocID
Field.Description: Unique identifier for a specific allocation.

Field.Name: OrderCapacity
Field.Description: Firm's capacity.

Field.Name: CrossID
Field.Description: Only present if execution report is for a fill or partial fill resulting from a New Order Cross message.

Field.Name: LegRefID
Field.Description: Identifier from the original order. Only present when tag 442 set to 2.

Field.Name: TradeID
Field.Description: MIAX assigned unique Trade ID.

Field.Name: MIAXExecInst
Field.Description: MIAX-specific execution instructions.

Field.Name: StockExecutionDestination
Field.Description: Stock execution destination.

Field.Name: AuctionID
Field.Description: Numeric Event ID when this execution relates to a liquidity gathering event at MIAX.

Field.Name: BillingMPID
Field.Description: MPID billed for this execution.

Field.Name: AdditionalBillingParameters
Field.Description: Additional billing parameters (see Appendix A).

Field.Name: FirmMPID
Field.Description: Executing Broker MPID (Firm MPID).

Field.Name: ExecTransType
Field.Description: Valid values: 0 = New Manual Trade (only due to clearing change), 1 = Trade Cancel, 2 = Trade Correct.

Field.Name: CorrectionType
Field.Description: Valid values: 1 = Not Applicable (trade cancel), 2 = Price and/or Size change, 3 = This side Clearing change, 4 = Contra side Clearing change, 5 = Both side Clearing change.

Field.Name: ExecID
Field.Description: Always the ExecID in the original trade.

Field.Name: TradeID
Field.Description: MIAX assigned unique Trade ID for the day. When not a New Manual Trade, same as the Trade ID of the cancelled or corrected trade.

Field.Name: OrigTradeID
Field.Description: TradeID of the trade being corrected. For a New Manual Trade, TradeID of the trade that had the clearing change correction resulting in this New Manual Trade.

Field.Name: CorrectionNum
Field.Description: Trade correction number. Used to identify version of the trade being corrected or canceled. Increments by 1 for each subsequent correction.

Field.Name: OrderID
Field.Description: From original trade.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: From original trade.

Field.Name: OrigTime
Field.Description: GMT date-time of trade being corrected or cancelled.

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: GMT date-time of the cancel/correct trade.

Field.Name: SecurityType
Field.Description: The type of security. Valid values: OPT or MLEG.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: From original trade.

Field.Name: MaturityMonthYear
Field.Description: From original trade, if option leg. Format: YYYYMM.

Field.Name: MaturityDay
Field.Description: From original trade, if option leg. Format: DD.

Field.Name: PutOrCall
Field.Description: From original trade, if option leg. Valid values: 0 = Put, 1 = Call.

Field.Name: StrikePrice
Field.Description: From original trade, if option leg.

Field.Name: CFICode
Field.Description: CFI code for the individual leg.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Side of order. Valid values: 1 = Buy, 2 = Sell.

Field.Name: LastPx
Field.Description: Price of the trade being corrected/cancelled.

Field.Name: LastShares
Field.Description: Quantity of the trade being corrected/cancelled.

Field.Name: OpenClose
Field.Description: Option leg only. If changed in correction, the latest corrected value, else the value supplied in the order.

Field.Name: ClientID
Field.Description: Option leg only. Clearing MPID.

Field.Name: Account
Field.Description: If changed in correction, the latest corrected value, else the value supplied in the order.

Field.Name: ClearingFirm
Field.Description: CMTA. If changed in correction, the latest corrected value, else the value supplied in the order.

Field.Name: ClearingAccount
Field.Description: If changed in correction, the latest corrected value, else the value supplied in the order.

Field.Name: MultiLegReportingType
Field.Description: Used to indicate what an Execution Report represents for Multileg orders only. Valid values: 2 = Individual Leg, 3 = Multileg Security.

Field.Name: OrderCapacity
Field.Description: Stock leg only. Firm's capacity for the stock leg. Valid values: A = Agency, P = Principal, R = Riskless Principal.

Field.Name: LegRefID
Field.Description: Identifier from the original order. Only present when tag 442 set to 2.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: If changed in correction, the latest corrected value, else the value supplied in the order.

Field.Name: StockExecutionDestination
Field.Description: Stock execution destination.

Field.Name: StockClearingAccount
Field.Description: Stock clearing account.

Field.Name: AdditionalBillingParameters
Field.Description: Latest changes to additional billing parameters. Same format as tag 9730 in the FOI/FXD execution report. Updates to Origin and Directed Firm Code (DFC) are sent here. See Appendix A.

Field.Name: RefSeqNum
Field.Description: MsgSeqNum of rejected message.

Field.Name: RefMsgType
Field.Description: MsgType of the FIX message being rejected.

Field.Name: BusinessRejectRefID
Field.Description: RefID of the message being rejected. ExecID if an Execution Report, ClOrdID if an Order/Cancel message, CrossID if a New Order Cross.

Field.Name: BusinessRejectReason
Field.Description: Code to identify reason for Business rejection. Valid values: 0 = Other, 3 = Unsupported Message Type.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Required if BusinessRejectReason = 0.
